cause_of_death.value: cerebral hemorrhage (passed away with the clinical picture of cerebral hemorrhage, after 25 days comatose)

treatment_summary.value: Packed cells and platelets transfused at another center; methylprednisolone pulse therapy (30 mg/kg, three doses in 3 days), intravenous etoposide (5 mg/kg/dose, three doses) and oral cyclosporine (5 mg/kg/day); discharged on oral dexamethasone and cyclosporine. At 2 years 4 months receiving etoposide every 2 weeks, oral dexamethasone and cotrimoxazole syrup (treatment never stopped since 4 months). Etanercept prescribed after WES but never started (family did not initiate, apparently due to cost).
